visual.general_description: Nine EEG scalp maps in a 3 by 3 grid: rows delta, theta, alpha; columns hallucinations, resting-state, comparison; dB and t-value color bars.
visual.detailed_description: A white-background composite of nine oval head maps seen from above, each with a small nose-shaped triangle at the top edge. Bold column titles read hallucinations, resting-state and comparison; bold rotated row titles read delta, theta and alpha. In the first two columns each map is a smoothly interpolated color field running from black and dark teal through blue, purple and magenta to orange and white, with a horizontal color bar labelled dB under each map (ticks 0 to 30 in steps of 5 for delta, 0 to 25 for theta, 0 to 20 for alpha). In the delta and theta rows the front (top) of both maps is orange to white and the back (bottom) is purple to blue. The alpha maps are mostly orange to white, with a purple-blue region at the back of the resting-state map and small purple spots near the lower left of the hallucinations map. The third column shows comparison maps on a color bar labelled t-values with ticks -6, -4, -2, 0, 2, 4, 6. Small circular dots are overlaid on the comparison maps: delta has about nine white dots in the upper half and five black dots in the lower midline orange patch; theta has about 23 white dots clustered in the upper half and five black dots in the lower midline; alpha has no white dots and about two dozen black dots in a triangular cluster over the lowest part of the map. No numeric values are printed on the maps, and the left and right sides are not labelled.

visual.general_description: Four EEG power spectral density plots (Fz, Cz, Pz, Oz) comparing hallucinations (orange) and resting-state (gray-blue) over a head scheme.
visual.detailed_description: A large black oval head outline with a nose-shaped triangle at the top, containing many tiny black dots that mark electrode positions. Four small line plots are stacked down the midline, each with a bold label printed to its left: Fz at the top, then Cz, Pz and Oz at the bottom. In each plot the x axis is labelled Hz (ticks 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12; the data run from about 1 to 13) and the y axis is labelled dB (Fz ticks 15, 20, 25, 30; Cz ticks 10, 15, 20, 25; Pz ticks 10, 15, 20, 25; Oz ticks 8 to 24 in steps of 2). Each plot holds two solid lines, each with a narrow shaded band: orange for hallucinations and gray-blue for resting-state, as given by the legend at the lower right. All curves fall steeply from about 1 to 3 Hz and then decline more slowly with a local bump between about 6 and 9 Hz. At Fz the gray-blue resting-state curve lies above the orange curve between about 3.5 and 10 Hz. At Cz the two curves nearly coincide around the bump, with the orange curve slightly above between about 2 and 4 Hz and above 8 Hz. At Pz the orange curve lies above the gray-blue curve over most of the range from about 2.5 Hz. At Oz the orange curve lies above the gray-blue curve below about 6 Hz and above about 8 Hz, with the curves meeting near 7 Hz, where the gray-blue curve has its bump while the orange curve has a broad bump around 8 to 9 Hz.

In A, B and C the orange bar is lower than the dark teal bar; in D it is higher; in E it is lower. A black bracket line joins the two bars in panels A to D and none is drawn in E. A stray text fragment (Ha) overlaps the hallucinations x label in E.

visual.general_description: Nine Lempel-Ziv complexity scalp maps in a 3 by 3 grid: rows delta, theta, alpha; columns hallucinations, resting-state, comparison; complexity and t-value color bars.
visual.detailed_description: A white-background composite of nine oval head maps seen from above, each with a small nose-shaped triangle at the top edge, in the same 3 by 3 layout as Figure 1: bold column titles hallucinations, resting-state and comparison; bold rotated row titles delta, theta and alpha. Each row has a horizontal color bar labelled Lempel-Ziv Complexity under the first two maps (ticks 0.31 to 0.34 for delta and theta, 0.44 to 0.5 for alpha) and a color bar labelled t-values under the comparison map (ticks -3 to 3). The complexity maps are patchy mosaics of purple, blue, orange and white with dark teal or black patches. In the delta row both maps have a bright white-orange region near the center of the head, with dark patches at the right edge and lower border of the hallucinations map and at the lower right of the resting-state map. In the theta row the hallucinations map has an elongated dark teal-black patch left of center and a white patch at the lower left edge, and the resting-state map has white patches at the upper right and lower right. In the alpha row the hallucinations map is mostly orange to white and the resting-state map is mostly purple-blue with some orange patches. The delta and theta comparison maps have no dots; the alpha comparison map, an orange and magenta mosaic, has 10 black dots: four in an upper central cluster, four along a diagonal on the right and two at the lower left. No white dots appear and no numeric values are printed on the maps; left and right sides are not labelled.
